elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3 applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form for any reason and requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) specifies transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor must return all Customer Data upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires Vendor to “return all Customer Data” after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) sets a deadline of “within 30 days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor to “thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor to certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) provides transition assistance for up to six months, which encompasses the fallback 90-day period and is exercisable at Customer's request.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires return of all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added Section 10.3 implements every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is narrowly focused on transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification without altering unrelated commercial terms. The Customer-request condition appropriately makes transition assistance elective for Customer and does not condition the automatic data-return obligation.
